name: Meadowsweet
note: Meadowsweet, Filipendula ulmaria (docs/future/13 section 5, P2b). A tea herb: the walker gathers its flowers in high summer (recipes/world/gather.json meadowsweet.flowers). Drawn with the thrift shader (draw: thrift; flora-thrift.wgsl), so its keys are the thrift's: a loose stand of broad leaves, tall reddish stalks and frothy cream heads (round heads for now; P2b B2 gives them their flat, frothy shape). habitat (docs/future/13 5.3): damp soil near fresh water, never standing in it (at most 1 cm), never salt. growth: the herb defaults of 5.4, drowning under 10 cm of water for 72 hours. It flowers in high summer and rests as a low crown in winter (dormant). spread kind rhizome as in watermint.json, creeping in spring into summer, up to maxCount on the island. volunteer.seasons: spring to autumn. starter: test links only. plantTool false: gather plants are not offered by the Plant tool.

phenology.note: each plant keeps its own calendar, offset from the species by up to jitterDays game days either way (hash of the plant id; src/world/growth/phenology.js)
